name: Aurora::{new, resize, render_rgba, render_text}

test_list.description: After pre-filling the buffer with garbage render_rgba overwrites all w*h*4 bytes and every alpha byte is 255.
A buffer of the wrong length yields AuroraError::BufferSize with expected and actual.
Internal buffer pointers are identical before and after many frames.
Resizing to the same size keeps all internal buffers untouched.
Resizing to a new size changes the cell grid and buffer lengths.
Each axis is clamped to the configured maximum and cols/rows are ceil(px / cell).
A zero cell width or height is rejected with AuroraError::Size.
Two renders of the same (seed, size, t) are byte-identical.
For arbitrary t in [0,600] a small frame renders without error and with alpha 255.
Empty cells show a faint grid line on the right and bottom pixel of the cell, brighter than the cell interior.
At 96x40 cells and t=12 between 60% and 75% of cells are blank spaces.
insta snapshot of the 96x40 text render at t=12.
Ignored visual check: renders 1440x900 at t=12 and t=20 and writes binary PPM files for review.
Ignored release-only timing: the average of 30 frames at 1920x1080 stays under 15 ms.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Cell size, seed and maximum pixel size.

inputs.name: font
inputs.description: Monospace font bytes for the glyph atlas.

inputs.name: t_seconds, out
inputs.description: Simulation time and the destination RGBA8 buffer.

output_description: Straight opaque RGBA8 pixels written without allocation, or rows of ramp glyphs joined by newlines.
